inputs.text: Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, isn’t offering a careful plan to protect watersheds—it’s demanding that government “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration.” That’s a blanket ban dressed up as environmental concern, and it risks putting activists’ priorities ahead of the families and communities whose livelihoods depend on work and a strong Alberta economy. Protecting clean water is essential, but responsible government should enforce sensible safeguards and listen to local people, not let a signature campaign turn every resource decision into a choice between water and prosperity.
